data.name: LoginIntro
data.value: Sign in with your GSIP account. Privileged accounts follow MFA and forced-password-change controls before the workspace opens.

data.name: RememberMe
data.value: Remember this account on this trusted browser

data.name: AuthInvalid
data.value: The username or password is not valid.

data.name: AuthLocked
data.value: This account is temporarily locked after repeated failed attempts. Try again later or contact an authorized administrator.

data.name: AuthDisabled
data.value: This account is disabled. Contact an authorized administrator.

data.name: SecureSessionNotice
data.value: Credentials, MFA codes and authentication secrets are never written to application logs or audit payloads.

data.name: MfaEnrollIntro
data.value: Add the key to an authenticator app, then enter the current six-digit code to activate MFA.

data.name: MfaVerifyIntro
data.value: Enter the current code from your registered authenticator to continue.

data.name: MfaInvalid
data.value: The authentication code is invalid or expired.

data.name: PasswordChangeIntro
data.value: Your account requires a password change before normal access is allowed.

data.name: PasswordMismatch
data.value: The new password and confirmation do not match.

data.name: PasswordChangeRejected
data.value: The password change was rejected. Check the current password and configured password policy.
